text:
anya: FYI the aggregate backfill for `agg-hours-v2` started hitting failures after the third shard, seeing count spikes and some duplicates. job id 2026-agg-replay-73

david: ugh. what errors in the logs?

anya: mostly upsert conflicts and a handful of time-window overlaps when the rollback checkpoint moved back. logs show `duplicate_key_violation` on write to agg_store. also noticed the KV-cache rehydrate was disabled for that run.

kevin: did we pin the checkpointing mode? we have two modes: incremental-checkpoint and idempotent-writes. looks like this run used incremental. that explains the overlap.

jen: incremental is faster but brittle with late-arriving events. for SLA-sensitive runs we should switch to idempotent-writes or add deterministic dedupe in the writer.

anya: agree. can we abort the current job and relaunch with idempotent-writes flag? how disruptive is abort mid-replay?
kevin: abort is safe but leaves consumers with partial aggregates. consumers read via the console's "backfill view" which shows in-progress deltas. we need a clear rollback/commit boundary. otherwise dashboards will show intermediate inconsistent numbers.
david: SRE perspective: abort now and relaunch is OK if we mark the partial outputs as ephemeral. we have `replayctl mark-ephemeral job=2026-agg-replay-73` to make queries ignore them.

anya: trying that now... `replayctl mark-ephemeral --job 2026-agg-replay-73`
sre-bot: [deploy-bot] Job 2026-agg-replay-73 marked ephemeral by anya at 2360001225.

anya: job marked. relaunch plan: (1) enable idempotent-writes (2) enable KV-cache rehydrate (3) run a small dry-run on 3 shards with new config (4) if green, full relaunch with concurrency throttled to SLA lane.
kevin: +1. we also need a fallback routing policy in the control plane: if a replay run toggles checkpoint backwards more than X minutes, auto-stop and create an incident. prevents long tail corruptions.
jen: what's X? 30m? 1h? remember EU customers often have longer ingestion swing.
eva: propose 45m as default, configurable per-tenant. console should show the detector and allow operators to override for specific runs. UX idea: a "safety fence" toggle when launching a backfill that shows estimated time and rollback sensitivity.
david: +1 to UI. add metrics: "checkpoint-moves", "write-conflicts", and an alert if write-conflicts > 0.1% of total writes for a run.
kevin: will add a quiet-mode for console to hide ephemeral partials from dashboards until commit. that reduces noise for product dashboards.
anya: dry-run results: 3 shards tried, idempotent writes prevented duplicates, KV-rehydrate cut token ops by ~28%. small perf hit (~6% slower) but no conflicts.
david: sounds acceptable. SLA lane: set concurrency to 8 workers, backoff jitter 0.2s, and throttle to keep 99th percentile token latency under SLO.
jen: can we capture a prerelease telemetry snapshot before the relaunch so we can diff for regressions? also trigger the eval harness on a random sample of queries.
anya: created snapshot: `telemetry-snap-2360001300`. relaunch command I plan to run: `replay-run --job 2026-agg-replay-74 --mode idempotent-writes --kv-rehydrate true --concurrency 8 --safety-fence 45m --snapshot telemetry-snap-2360001300`
eva: I'll add a small console banner and mark the run as "SLA lane" so customers can opt in/out of seeing intermediate numbers.
kevin: follow-ups: (A) add server-side check to block incremental mode for runs touching >10M keys, (B) expose `checkpoint-moves` metric in the backfill view, (C) doc the abort/ephemeral flow in runbook.
david: I'll file a short incident-avoidance ticket for the metrics and threshold: PF-4621. link it to the run.
anya: thanks team. relaunching in 15m unless objections.
david: no objections. go for it. :thumbsup:

kevin: thanks — if we see any write-conflict spikes we'll auto-flip to single-writer mode for safety.
anya: relaunch kicked off: job 2026-agg-replay-74 started at 2360001450. tracking in repo and console. will post results in this thread.
sre-bot: [replay-bot] Job 2026-agg-replay-74 started by anya at 2360001450. status: running.
anya: first 3 shard sanity check green. no dupes, checkpoint stable. continuing to ramp.
jen: nice. remind me to add the safety-fence toggle to the run template before end of sprint.
anya: noted. closing loop when job finishes.
